verdict.rationale: Factory's own docs say Droid connects to MCP tools alongside Jira, Notion, Slack, Linear and PagerDuty. The Droid CLI is described as exposing 'MCP tools' within the same runtime, and the App syncs sessions with MCP tools. That shows Factory acts as an MCP client that can use external servers' tools, but the cited material only mentions it briefly. Missing for 10: configuration details for adding MCP servers (transport types, config file or command, auth), any limits on tool use, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect Jira, Notion, Slack, Linear, PagerDuty, and MCP tools to keep development synchronized with team systems
It gives the same Factory runtime through an interactive terminal UI with project context, approvals, MCP tools, Missions, and headless execution.
synchronized with Jira, Notion, Slack, Linear, PagerDuty, and MCP tools.
